title: Spur Gear Parameterization
summary: Expose gear pitch radius, number of teeth, face width, bore radius, and pressure angle so generated gears remain editable.
parameter_hints: Expose number of teeth as an integer parameter.;Expose pitch radius as a length parameter.;Expose pressure angle for standard tooth forms.
modeling_notes: Compute involute gear geometry from runtime parameters.;Avoid hardcoding tooth count or radius into the feature body.;Keep the generated feature editable rather than fixed.
feature_pattern: Parameterize numTeeth, radius, pressureAngleDegrees, faceWidth, and holeRadius; generate involute tooth profiles in a loop and extrude the final profile.
failure_modes: Do not hardcode the number of teeth or pitch radius.;Do not omit a user-editable pressure angle.;Do not expose only face width without allowing gear size adjustments.
validation_rules: numTeeth must be an integer and at least 6.;pressureAngleDegrees should be between 10 and 30.;Bore radius must be smaller than pitch radius.
example_prompt: Generate a 24 tooth spur gear with 2.5 inch pitch radius, 20° pressure angle, 0.5 inch face width, and 0.25 inch bore radius
